title: 第26章 夜测灵根
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
收回飞剑后，陈凡体内的筑基期法力在经脉中平稳运转，将最后一丝燥热之气驱散干净。

    他站起身，看了一眼石墙上挂着的一阶警戒阵盘。

    灵石微光在阵纹中缓缓流动，外界百丈内的一切风吹草动尽在神识掌控之中。

    柳溪镇终究只是歇脚之地。

    如今金螭剑已至一阶极品巅峰，想要突破到二阶法器，凡人集镇和底层黑市已经无法提供后续材料，尤其是可遇不可求的庚金矿石。

    “在离开前，还要处理些手尾。”陈凡自语道。

    修仙者修的是顺天应人，讲究因果不昧。

    他曾受过林小婉的一饭之恩，林家大难时，他安排林小婉一年来到柳溪镇，虽说林大山死在逃亡路上。

    从世俗道义上讲，当年的恩情已经还清。

    但他脑海中融了邪修老祖的残魂，还融合了真正林家老祖的一丝残念，占据了林家大运。

    若带着这层未了的因果强行去闯荡，日后突破境界时，难免会演变成心魔。

    陈凡行事谨慎，绝不容许修仙道途留下隐患。

    深夜，子时。

    集市两旁的铺子早已卸了门板，四下漆黑，唯有几盏灯笼在风中摇晃，发出咯吱声响。

    陈凡换上普通的夜行衣，没有催动飞剑，而是脚尖轻点地面，身形如青烟般飘出小院。

    一阶上品身法，神行术。

    以筑基初期的法力催动低阶法术，速度极快且毫无破空之声，凡人根本不可能察觉。

    数息之后，他便落在了茶馆后院的围墙外。

    这是一座破败的土木小院，院内堆着几担柴火，柴刀插在木桩上。

    陈凡双眼微眯，眼底闪过一抹金芒。

    一阶法术，金芒术。

    此术能通过灵气流向辨别凡人与修士。

    在他的神识探查中，屋内躺着三个人。

    一间房里是林小婉，呼吸绵长却透着虚弱，显然是平日劳作过度伤了气血。

    另一人气血衰败，应是林母。

    看样子逃亡和林父的死对她打击颇大，已无多少寿元。

    而在另一间狭窄的柴房里，十二岁的林小虎正盘膝坐在简陋的草席上。

    他并未入睡。

    月光透过残破的窗纸洒在少年脸上，映出一张因营养不良而瘦削的脸庞。

    他双手掐着拙劣的印诀，正按照林家族学教的《基础吐纳术》，费力地感应着天地灵气。

    “一，二，三……”
content_en:
After retracting the flying sword, the foundation-building magic power in Chen Fan's body circulated smoothly in his meridians, dissipating the last trace of hot air.

    He stood up and glanced at the first-order warning array hanging on the stone wall.

    The faint light of the spirit stone flows slowly in the formation, and all the disturbances within a hundred feet of the outside world are under the control of the divine consciousness.

    After all, Willow Creek is just a resting place.

    Now that the Golden Chi Sword has reached the pinnacle of the first-level magic weapon, if you want to break through to the second-level magic weapon, the mortal market town and the low-level black market can no longer provide follow-up materials, especially the rare Geng gold ore.

    "Before we leave, we need to take care of some things." Chen Fan said to himself.

    Immortal cultivators cultivate obedience to nature and people, and pay attention to the unambiguity of cause and effect.

    He once received a favor from Lin Xiaowan. When the Lin family was in disaster, he arranged for Lin Xiaowan to come to Liuxi Town for one year, although Lin Dashan died on the way to escape.

    From a secular and moral perspective, the debt of gratitude has been repaid.

    But the remnant soul of the evil cultivator ancestor was fused in his mind, as well as a trace of the real ancestor of the Lin family, and he took over the great fortune of the Lin family.

    If you forcefully go out with this layer of unfinished cause and effect, you will inevitably turn into an inner demon when you break through the realm in the future.

    Chen Fan acts cautiously and will never allow hidden dangers to be left in his path to immortality.

    Late at night, midnight.

    The shops on both sides of the market had already removed their door panels, and everything was dark except for a few lanterns swaying in the wind and making creaking sounds.

    Chen Fan put on ordinary night clothes, did not activate the flying sword, but tapped the ground with his toes, and floated out of the small courtyard like green smoke.

    First-level high-grade body skills and divine movement skills.

    Using the mana in the initial stage of foundation building to activate low-level spells, the speed is extremely fast and there is no sound of breaking through the air, making it impossible for mortals to detect it.

    After a few breaths, he landed outside the wall of the teahouse's backyard.

    This is a dilapidated small courtyard made of earth and wood. There are several loads of firewood piled in the courtyard, and the hatchets are stuck on the wooden piles.

    Chen Fan narrowed his eyes slightly, and a golden light flashed in his eyes.

    A first-level spell, Golden Light Technique.

    This technique can distinguish between mortals and monks through the flow of spiritual energy.

    During his spiritual exploration, he found three people lying in the room.

    In one room was Lin Xiaowan. Her breathing was long but weak. It was obvious that she had damaged her energy and blood due to overwork.

    Another person with declining Qi and blood must be Mother Lin.

    It seemed that the escape and Lin's father's death had hit her hard, and she didn't have much life left.

    In another narrow woodshed, twelve-year-old Lin Xiaohu was sitting cross-legged on a simple straw mat.

    He did not fall asleep.

    The moonlight shines on the young man's face through the broken window paper, reflecting a face that is thin due to malnutrition.

    He was holding clumsy seals with both hands, and was laboriously sensing the aura of heaven and earth according to the "Basic Breathing Technique" taught by the Lin family.

    "one two three……"
title_en: Chapter 26 Night Test of Spiritual Roots
